value.rationale: Orders 9 and 13 are the two highest of the standard five diagonal Padé orders for the widely used scaling-and-squaring matrix exponential. Their all-index coefficient signs form an explicit natural unresolved slice of Conjecture 3.2 (after recent off-diagonal counterexamples), and allow the precise positivity-dependent error-bound step for these algorithmic orders. The exact infinite-tail certificates settle rather than merely approximate the sign of every coefficient. They do not imply overall matrix algorithm stability.
